      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## **Part 2 (10 points, non-coding task)**\n",
        "\n",
        "The recursive equation that defines the sequence in this problem can be written in a matrix form:\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\\begin{bmatrix}\n",
        "F_n \\\\\n",
        "F_{n-1}\n",
        "\\end{bmatrix}\n",
        "= \\mathbf{A}\n",
        "\\begin{bmatrix}\n",
        "F_{n-1} \\\\\n",
        "F_{n-2}\n",
        "\\end{bmatrix}, \\ \\forall \\ n \\geq 2 ,\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\n",
        "where $\\mathbf{A} \\in \\Bbb R^{2 \\times 2}$.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Compute $\\mathbf{A}$.**\n",
        "\n",
        "* Reasoning is not required.\n",
        "\n",
        "* The value of each entry in $\\mathbf{A}$ must be exact. For instance, the following values are exact: $\\sqrt{3}$, $\\frac{2}{\\sqrt{7}}$, $\\pi + \\frac{3}{8}$, $e^2$, $\\sin 40^\\circ$, $\\log 18$. However, their float approximations are not exact.\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "cIel-VkjVTgu"
      }
    },

      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "$\\color{green}{\\text{WRITE YOUR SOLUTION IN THIS TEXT CELL.}}$\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## **Part 3 (10 points, non-coding task)**\n",
        "\n",
        "**Explain why $\\mathbf{A}$ is a symmetric matrix.**"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "pNNPrqOBiMd-"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "$\\color{green}{\\text{WRITE YOUR SOLUTION IN THIS TEXT CELL.}}$\n",
        "\n",
        "Because\n",
        "\n",
        "$\\mathbf{A}^\\top = \\mathbf{A} = \\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 \\\\ 1 & 0 \\end{bmatrix}$ ,\n",
        "matrix $\\mathbf{A}$ is symmetric.\n",
        "\n",
        "$\\color{red}{\\text{\"\"\" END OF THIS PART \"\"\"}}$\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "TcNuVrC-iXkc"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## **Part 4 (10 points, non-coding task)**\n",
        "\n",
        "**In this part, you are asked to prove a general result that holds for any real-valued symmetric matrix.**\n",
        "\n",
        "Let $\\mathbf{U} \\in \\Bbb R^{N \\times N}$ be a real-valued symmetric matrix.\n",
        "\n",
        "Consider the following eigenvalue equation\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\\mathbf{U} \\mathbf{v} = \\lambda \\mathbf{v} ,\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\n",
        "where $\\lambda \\in \\Bbb R$ and $\\mathbf{v} \\in \\Bbb R^{N \\times 1}$.\n",
        "\n",
        "Let $\\lambda_i$ and $\\lambda_j$ be two distinct real eigenvalues and $\\mathbf{v}_i, \\mathbf{v}_j \\in \\Bbb R^{N \\times 1}$ be two eigenvectors associated with them, respectively.\n",
        "\n",
        "Prove that\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{v}_j = 0 .\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\n",
        "That is, vectors $\\mathbf{v}_i$ and $\\mathbf{v}_j$ are orthogonal."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "0-a-rDVwi14f"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "$\\color{green}{\\text{WRITE YOUR SOLUTION IN THIS TEXT CELL.}}$\n",
        "\n",
        "We use two approaches to compute\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{U} \\mathbf{v}_j .$$\n",
        "Approach 1\n",
        "\n",
        "We have\n",
        "\n",
        "\\begin{align*} \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{U} \\mathbf{v}_j & = \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\left( \\mathbf{U} \\mathbf{v}_j \\right) \\\\ & = \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\left( \\lambda_j \\mathbf{v}_j \\right) \\\\ & = \\lambda_j \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{v}_j . \\hspace{1cm} (1) \\end{align*}\n",
        "Approach 2\n",
        "\n",
        "We have\n",
        "\n",
        "\\begin{align*} \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{U} \\mathbf{v}_j & = \\left( \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{U} \\right) \\mathbf{v}_j \\\\ & = \\left( \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{U}^\\top \\right) \\mathbf{v}_j \\\\ & = \\left( \\mathbf{U} \\mathbf{v}_i \\right)^\\top \\mathbf{v}_j \\\\ & = \\left( \\lambda_i \\mathbf{v}_i \\right)^\\top \\mathbf{v}_j \\\\ & = \\lambda_i \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{v}_j , \\hspace{1cm} (2) \\end{align*}\n",
        "where the second equality follows from the property that $\\mathbf{U}$ is a symmetric matrix.\n",
        "\n",
        "Two approaches should yield the same result. Equating (1) and (2), we have\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\lambda_j \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{v}_j = \\lambda_i \\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{v}_j .$$\n",
        "Because $\\lambda_i \\neq \\lambda_j$, we must have\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\mathbf{v}_i^\\top \\mathbf{v}_j = 0 .$$\n",
        "This completes the proof.\n",
        "\n",
        "$\\color{red}{\\text{\"\"\" END OF THIS PART \"\"\"}}$\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "63PRoXmUj6nt"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## **Part 5 (10 points, non-coding task)**\n",
        "\n",
        "Let us go back to our matrix $\\mathbf{A}$.\n",
        "\n",
        "In the following eigenvalue equation\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\\mathbf{A} \\mathbf{x} = \\lambda \\mathbf{x} ,\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\n",
        "**compute two eigenvalues $\\lambda_0$ and $\\lambda_1$ whose values are in a descending order.**\n",
        "\n",
        "* Reasoning is required."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "O6k0e86EYPuX"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "$\\color{green}{\\text{### WRITE YOUR SOLUTION HERE ###}}$\n",
        "\n",
        "We solve the following characteristic equation:\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\det \\left( \\mathbf{A} - \\lambda \\mathbf{I} \\right) = 0 .$$\n",
        "Thus, we compute \\lambda that satisfies\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\left( 1 - \\lambda \\right) \\left( - \\lambda \\right) - 1 \\cdot 1 = 0 .$$\n",
        "Hence, all eigenvalues are\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\boxed{\\lambda_0 = \\frac{1 + \\sqrt{5}}{2} , \\quad \\lambda_1 = \\frac{1 - \\sqrt{5}}{2} .}$$\n",
        "\n",
        "$\\color{red}{\\text{\"\"\" END OF THIS PART \"\"\"}}$\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "sIFK7gB7Ywwd"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "**In the remaining parts of this problem, for all non-coding tasks, when you need to use those eigenvalues,**\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\\color{red}{\\textbf{keep them as $\\lambda_0$ and $\\lambda_1$. No need to apply their formulae.}}\n",
        "$$"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "6R3G5Jbrbb5Q"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## **Part 6 (10 points, non-coding task)**\n",
        "\n",
        "**Since matrix $\\mathbf{A}$ is symmetric, let us do the spectral decomposition of it.**\n",
        "\n",
        "That is, you should write $\\mathbf{A}$ in the following form:\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\\mathbf{A} = \\mathbf{Q} \\mathbf{\\Lambda} \\mathbf{Q}^\\top ,\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\n",
        "where\n",
        "\n",
        "* $\\mathbf{Q} \\in \\Bbb R^{2 \\times 2}$ is an orthonormal matrix.\n",
        "\n",
        "* $\\mathbf{\\Lambda} = \\begin{bmatrix} \\lambda_0 & 0 \\\\ 0 & \\lambda_1 \\end{bmatrix} \\in \\Bbb R^{2 \\times 2}$ is a diagnomal matrix with $\\lambda_0 > \\lambda_1$\n",
        "\n",
        "**In this task, you need to compute $\\mathbf{Q}$. Reasoning is required.**"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "hnAGJ-YSXc9z"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "$\\color{green}{\\text{### WRITE YOUR SOLUTION HERE ###}}$\n",
        "\n",
        "To compute an eigenvector $\\mathbf{x}_i$ associated with the eigenvalue $\\lambda_i$ for $i \\in \\left\\{ 0, 1 \\right\\}$, we solve the following equation:\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\begin{bmatrix} 1 - \\lambda_i & 1 \\\\ 1 & - \\lambda_i \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} x_{i0} \\\\ x_{i1} \\end{bmatrix} = \\begin{bmatrix} 0 \\\\ 0 \\end{bmatrix} .$$\n",
        "\n",
        "Since the determintant of the 2-by-2 matrix on the L.H.S. is 0, the rank of this matrix is 1. Thus, it is sufficient to only solve the following equation:\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\begin{bmatrix} 1 & - \\lambda_i \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} x_{i0} \\\\ x_{i1} \\end{bmatrix} = \\begin{bmatrix} 0 \\\\ 0 \\end{bmatrix} .$$\n",
        "\n",
        "One solution is\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\mathbf{x}_i = \\begin{bmatrix} x_{i0} \\\\ x_{i1} \\end{bmatrix} = \\begin{bmatrix} \\lambda_i \\\\ 1 \\end{bmatrix} .$$\n",
        "\n",
        "Thus, the $i$th orthonormal vector is\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\begin{align*} \\mathbf{q}_i & = \\frac{\\mathbf{x}_i}{|| \\mathbf{x}_i ||_2} \\\\ & = \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_i^2}} \\begin{bmatrix} \\lambda_i \\\\ 1 \\end{bmatrix} . \\end{align*}$$\n",
        "Therefore,\n",
        "\n",
        "\\begin{align*} \\mathbf{Q} = \\boxed{\\begin{bmatrix} \\frac{\\lambda_0}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{\\lambda_1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\\\ \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\end{bmatrix} }. \\end{align*}\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "$\\color{red}{\\text{\"\"\" END OF THIS PART \"\"\"}}$\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "N1DmPJN-a2b1"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## **Part 7 (10 points, non-coding task)**\n",
        "\n",
        "**Use the spectral decomposition result to derive a closed form of $F_{n}$ for any $n \\in \\left\\{ 0, 1, \\cdots \\right\\}$.**\n",
        "\n",
        "* Reasoning is required.\n",
        "\n",
        "* Your answer shall be written in terms of $\\lambda_0$, $\\lambda_1$, and $F_0$ and $F_1$."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "5izpeRRUbiAN"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "$\\color{green}{\\text{### WRITE YOUR SOLUTION HERE ###}}$\n",
        "\n",
        "For $n \\geq 1$, we have\n",
        "\n",
        "\\begin{align*} \\begin{bmatrix} F_n \\\\ F_{n-1} \\end{bmatrix} & = \\mathbf{A}^{n-1} \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} \\\\ & = \\left( \\mathbf{Q} \\mathbf{\\Lambda} \\mathbf{Q}^\\top \\right)^{n-1} \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} \\\\ & = \\mathbf{Q} \\mathbf{\\Lambda}^{n-1} \\mathbf{Q}^\\top \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} . \\end{align*}\n",
        "Thus, for $n \\geq 1$, we have\n",
        "\n",
        "\\begin{align*} F_n & = \\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\end{bmatrix} \\mathbf{A} \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} \\\\ & = \\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\end{bmatrix} \\mathbf{Q} \\mathbf{\\Lambda}^{n-1} \\mathbf{Q}^\\top \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} \\\\ & = \\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} \\frac{\\lambda_0}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{\\lambda_1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\\\ \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} \\lambda_0^{n-1} & 0 \\\\ 0 & \\lambda_1^{n-1} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} \\frac{\\lambda_0}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} \\\\ \\frac{\\lambda_1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} & \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} \\\\ & = \\begin{bmatrix} \\frac{\\lambda_0}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{\\lambda_1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} \\lambda_0^{n-1} & 0 \\\\ 0 & \\lambda_1^{n-1} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} \\frac{\\lambda_0}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} \\\\ \\frac{\\lambda_1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} & \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} \\\\ & = \\begin{bmatrix} \\frac{\\lambda_0^n}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{\\lambda_1^n}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} \\frac{\\lambda_0}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} & \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_0^2}} \\\\ \\frac{\\lambda_1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} & \\frac{1}{\\sqrt{1 + \\lambda_1^2}} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} \\\\ & = \\begin{bmatrix} \\frac{\\lambda_0^{n+1}}{1 + \\lambda_0^2} + \\frac{\\lambda_1^{n+1}}{1 + \\lambda_1^2} & \\frac{\\lambda_0^{n}}{1 + \\lambda_0^2} + \\frac{\\lambda_1^{n}}{1 + \\lambda_1^2} \\end{bmatrix} \\begin{bmatrix} F_1 \\\\ F_0 \\end{bmatrix} \\\\ & = \\boxed{\\left( \\frac{\\lambda_0^{n+1}}{1 + \\lambda_0^2} + \\frac{\\lambda_1^{n+1}}{1 + \\lambda_1^2} \\right) F_1 + \\left( \\frac{\\lambda_0^{n}}{1 + \\lambda_0^2} + \\frac{\\lambda_1^{n}}{1 + \\lambda_1^2} \\right) F_0} . \\end{align*}\n",
        "For $n = 0$, we can\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\frac{\\lambda_0^{0+1}}{1 + \\lambda_0^2} + \\frac{\\lambda_1^{0+1}}{1 + \\lambda_1^2} = 0$$\n",
        "\n",
        "and\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\\frac{\\lambda_0^{0}}{1 + \\lambda_0^2} + \\frac{\\lambda_1^{0}}{1 + \\lambda_1^2} = 1 .$$\n",
        "Therefore, the above answer holds for all $n \\in \\left\\{ 0, 1, \\cdots \\right\\}$.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "$\\color{red}{\\text{\"\"\" END OF THIS PART \"\"\"}}$\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {

        "## **Part 8 (10 points, non-coding task)**\n",
        "\n",
        "**Compute**\n",
        "\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\\lim_{n \\rightarrow \\infty} \\ \\frac{F_n}{F_{n-1}} .\n",
        "$$\n",
        "\n",
        "* Reasoning is required.\n",
        "\n",
        "* Your answer shall be written in terms of one or two eigenvalues."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "DvQe9qHCcnGl"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "$\\color{green}{\\text{### WRITE YOUR SOLUTION HERE ###}}$\n",
        "\n",
        "We notice that $| \\lambda_0 | > 1$ and $| \\lambda_1 | < 1$.\n",
        "\n",
        "Hence,\n",
        "\n",
        "\\begin{align*} \\lim_{n \\rightarrow \\infty} \\ \\frac{F_n}{F_{n-1}} & = \\boxed{\\lambda_0 } . \\end{align*}\n",
        "\n",
        "$\\color{red}{\\text{\"\"\" END OF THIS PART \"\"\"}}$\n"

      "source": [
        "### WRITE YOUR SOLUTION HERE ###\n",
        "\n",
        "class My_Fib:\n",
        "    def __init__(self):\n",
        "        self.lambdas = np.array([(1 + 5**.5)/2, (1 - 5**.5)/2])\n",
        "        self.Q = np.stack([self.lambdas / np.sqrt(1 + self.lambdas**2), np.ones(2) / np.sqrt(1 + self.lambdas**2)])\n",
        "\n",
        "    def compute_fib(self, f0, f1, indices):\n",
        "        fib_values = (np.power(self.lambdas, np.array(indices)[:, np.newaxis]) / np.sqrt(1 + self.lambdas**2)) \\\n",
        "                         @ (self.Q.T @ np.array([f1, f0]))\n",
        "\n",
        "        fib_values = fib_values.astype(np.int32)\n",
        "        print(fib_values)\n",
        "        return fib_values\n",
        "\n",
        "    def plot_fib(self, f0, f1, indices):\n",
        "        fib_values = self.compute_fib(f0, f1, indices)\n",
        "        plt.plot(indices, fib_values, marker = \"x\", linestyle = \"--\", color = \"red\")\n",
        "        plt.xlabel('$n$')\n",
        "        plt.ylabel('$F_n$')\n",
        "        plt.title('Fibounacci sequence')\n",
        "\n",
        "\"\"\" END OF THIS PART \"\"\""
      ]
    },
